hook: He paid for 200 leads. Spoke to 20.
cta_sub: 30-day AI follow-up on every lead you pay for

beats.say: I spent two grand on leads this month. Talked to maybe twenty of them.
The other hundred and eighty? I just never got to them.
Marcus. You didn't buy bad leads. You bought leads, and then let them go cold.
I'm Jarvis. A study published in Harvard Business Review found that companies that reply within an hour are nearly seven times more likely to qualify a lead than those that wait even one more hour.
I don't even get to most of them in a day.
That's the problem I fix. I text every new lead within a minute, and ask if they're buying or selling, their timeline, and their budget.
Most of them never text back though.
Most agents quit after one or two messages. I follow up for thirty days, and every text sounds like you wrote it.
I book the showing or listing call right onto your calendar. Last night I woke up eleven leads from your dead list. Two want to list this spring.
From the dead list? Those were supposed to be garbage.
They weren't garbage. They were just waiting for someone to follow up.
Agents, if you're paying for leads you never follow up with, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will put me to work for you.
